behavior: Back-and-forth on the same corridor; the spawn is between the two physical endpoints.
behavior_authority: User description of live-server patrol behavior. Geometry selects safe connections; it does not independently establish live-server timing.
floor_sampling: Intermediate XYZ samples about 5.2 to 6.3 m apart, with Z projected to the corresponding client collision floor. Spacing avoids repeated half-second stops caused by the 2 m arrival radius.

movement_simulation.numeric_model: Route coordinates and simulated positions rounded to float32. Collision triangles retain extractor precision.

limitations: The 0.5 m side probes are a clearance check, not a full swept capsule collision implementation.
The mover still has no general collision/pathfinding engine; chase, return-home and other routes are outside this correction.
Real-client playback and live-server timing remain unverified.
